scope.purpose: Exact-name mechanics and Limit Burst refresh for high-impact PQ-linked thin records.

evidence.use: Maintained Super Soul catalogue corroborates mechanics and Limit Bursts for all four records.
Independent DAIMA-era documentation corroborates Super Soul 062's trigger, XL attack boost, Ki Auto-Recovery, and Auto Just Guard Limit Burst.
Independent historical Super Soul documentation corroborates Super Soul 064's Potential Unleashed trigger, attack/stamina recovery boosts, and duration.
Independent testing/discussion corroborates Super Soul 067's charged Ki Blast trigger, three-stack behavior, magnitudes, and Limit Burst.
Independent documentation corroborates Super Soul 068's revive-time reduction, one-time 50% Ki restoration, and Limit Burst.

limits: Acquisition probabilities are not treated as mechanics evidence.
No Ultimate-Finish requirement was inferred or changed.
